address: frazione San Barnaba 7, Villa di Chiavenna, 23029, Italy
bio: Thanks to its fireplace, the welcoming, classic-style dining room at this restaurant is perfect for winter dining, while its garden terrace attracts guests in summer. Whatever time of year you visit, you’ll enjoy cuisine which balances traditional recipes with more contemporary options and fish from the lake. The Tonola family have been renowned throughout the province (and further afield) for their gourmet cuisine and welcoming hospitality for over 40 years. Their appeal is even greater today, thanks to the combined efforts of young chef Roberto, who provides a skilful, modern touch in the kitchen, and his experienced parents who oversee the front of house.
